figma.description: Figma Remote MCP Server - OAuth-based, no desktop app required (link-based access)

figma-desktop.description: Figma Desktop MCP Server - Runs locally via Figma desktop app (selection-based access)

figma-developer-mcp.description: Figma Developer MCP Server - SSE server via npm package (token-based access)

sentry.description: Sentry Remote MCP Server - OAuth-based, 16+ tools for issues, error searching, Seer AI, releases, DSNs (RECOMMENDED)

vercel.description: Vercel Remote MCP Server - OAuth-based, 10+ tools for deployments, projects, build logs, domains (RECOMMENDED)

vercel-digitaltableteur.description: Vercel Project-Specific MCP - Automatic context for digitaltableteur_next project (enhanced performance, no need to specify project/team in prompts)

sentry-rest-api.description: Legacy REST API wrapper - Use for CI/CD summaries only, prefer 'sentry' for interactive debugging

context7.description: Context7 MCP Server - 2 tools: resolve-library-id (find library IDs), get-library-docs (fetch docs with topic/page pagination)

sanity.description: Sanity CMS MCP Server - 40+ tools for document operations, GROQ queries, semantic search, translations, version management, and content workflows

docker.description: Docker MCP Server - 30+ tools for container, image, network, volume, and compose management

inputs.description: GitHub Personal Access Token for MCP
